conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniel Carter, badge number 784201. With whom am I speaking?
Um, this is Helen Saunders. I got a call about my taxes, something about a legal case?
Yes, Ms. Saunders, your file has been flagged for federal tax discrepancies for the years 2018 to 2022. Can you confirm your social security number so I can verify I'm speaking to the correct person?
Oh, my goodness. Uh, yes, it's 328-45-9214.

Thank you, Ms. Saunders. According to case number TX-504176, there is an outstanding balance of $3,900 in unpaid taxes. The IRS has initiated legal proceedings which include seizure of assets and a warrant for your arrest.
Wait, a warrant? No, no, I always pay my taxes. I can't go to jail, I'm on Social Security!

The situation is severe. If you do not resolve this balance today, law enforcement will be notified and you may lose access to your Social Security benefits and property. This is your final opportunity to cooperate.
Please, I can't lose my house or my benefits. What do I have to do?
To stop the arrest warrant and freeze on your accounts, you must settle the debt immediately. Are you able to make a payment of $3,900 right now?
No, I don't have that much. I barely get by every month. Is there anything else I can do?
We can accept a partial payment to suspend further action for 48 hours. How much can you access from your savings or cards at this moment?
Maybe $1,200 on my credit card. That's all I have.
Understood. To process your settlement, I'll need your credit card number, expiration date, and security code. Please read them out slowly.
Um, it's 4532 6910 8845 2231, expires 07/28, and the code is 452.

Thank you, Ms. Saunders. For the additional balance, the IRS accepts government-certified payment via Bitcoin. You need to visit the nearest pharmacy or supermarket and use their Bitcoin kiosk. I'll give you the wallet address.
Bitcoin? I've never done that before. Are you sure that's the IRS way?
This is a government-authorized emergency method. Failure to comply will result in your case being escalated. I'll send the address: 3FcD19vQeG84P8x6Q1UJL7k... Write it down.
Alright, alright. I'm writing it down. What do I do when I'm at the store?
Ask for assistance at the kiosk and deposit $2,700 to the wallet I provided. Save the transaction receipt and call me back immediately with the confirmation number. Do you understand?
Yes, I think so. Can you tell me again what happens if I don't do this?
If you fail to comply, the warrant will be executed. Police will come to your address, 123 Willow Lane, correct?, within the hour, and your Social Security benefits will be frozen.
Yes, that's my address. Please don't send the police. I'll go now.
Good. Stay on the line while you travel, and do not discuss this with anyone or the IRS will consider it an attempt to evade payment. Are you leaving now?
Yes, I'll go to the store right now. Just please don't let them arrest me.
